title: ADR-042: Adopt PgBouncer for Connection Pooling
context: Incident INC-2031 caused connection pool exhaustion during a sudden traffic surge on Payments API.
decision: Deploy PgBouncer as a transaction-mode connection pooler sidecar for all tier-1 services.
consequences: Reduced idle Postgres connection count by 78%, capped max active client pool to 100, eliminated latency spikes.

title: ADR-043: Redis Cluster Multi-Region Caching
context: Global SSO latency in INC-2028 showed cross-region lock contention during JWKS token verification.
decision: Migrate from centralized single-region Redis to active-active replicated Redis Cluster.
consequences: P99 token validation latency dropped from 420ms to 12ms across international endpoints.

title: ADR-044: Kafka Event Streaming for Payment Notifications
context: Direct synchronous notifications caused thread starvation and backpressure during payment bursts.
decision: Adopt Apache Kafka with 3-day retention topics for decoupled event dispatch.
consequences: Guaranteed at-least-once message delivery with zero loss during downstream outages.

title: ADR-045: Circuit Breaker Pattern for External Billing Gateway
context: External billing processor timeouts caused cascading resource exhaustion in Payments API.
decision: Implement Resilience4j / Tenacity circuit breaker with exponential backoff and fast failure.
consequences: Immediate fallback responses for users and protected backend connection pools.

title: ADR-046: Incremental Snapshotting for Data Lake Pipelines
context: Full-table daily scans caused high disk I/O and executor OOM in Spark pipelines.
decision: Transition to Delta Lake incremental change data capture (CDC) with time-travel checkpoints.
consequences: ETL job execution time reduced from 4.5 hours to 18 minutes.

title: ADR-047: Elasticsearch Replica Sharding Optimization
context: Unbalanced shard allocation caused disk saturation on Elasticsearch primary nodes.
decision: Implement index lifecycle management (ILM) with automated rollover at 30GB per shard.
consequences: Prevented read-only index lockouts and stabilized search latency.

title: ADR-048: Automated Rate Limiting on Token Refresh Endpoints
context: Client reconnect storms overwhelmed authentication endpoints following network partitions.
decision: Deploy Redis token-bucket rate limiter enforcing 60 requests/minute per client IP.
consequences: Shields Keycloak from credential stuffing and thundering herd reconnection storms.

title: ADR-049: Asynchronous Webhook Retry Backoff with Dead Letter Queue
context: Synchronous retries against unresponsive partner webhooks blocked billing worker threads.
decision: Introduce dedicated SQS Dead Letter Queue with 5 exponential backoff retry attempts.
consequences: Isolated third-party partner downtime from core enterprise billing generation.
